title: Your hat is a little crushed
html_source: In the next chapter, Bloom tries to think of what he “should have said” to Menton.

anchor.text: Your hat is a little crushed
anchor.prefix:
Fellow always like that, mortified if women are by. 

 Got a dinge in the side of his hat. Carriage probably. 

 — Excuse me, sir, Mr Bloom said beside them. 

 They stopped. 

 —
anchor.suffix:
, Mr Bloom said pointing. 

 John Henry Menton stared at him for an instant without moving. 

 — There, Martin Cunningham helped, pointing also. John Henry Menton took off his hat,
anchor.canonical_text: Your hat is a little crushed
